cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Fluent in Nonsense
cards.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. To get your sofa off the ceiling, turn the gravity dial politely.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm losing my deposit. How do I turn politely?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Pause at each number. They dislike being passed over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Six clicked, but now the armchairs are rising.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six has invited witnesses. Apologize to the whole suite; private apologies don't count once furniture assembles.

mechanism: A assumes final authority over a strange procedure, converting requests for explanation into permission to proceed under newly invented rules.
confusable: Ordinary expert explanation is confusable: A must control the terms of B proceeding, and invent a rule specifically in response to each new result.
comparison: The cloud sale involves training an assistant; the furniture emergency involves a tenant seeking practical rescue and challenging the supposed expert.
seedUse: Read all four canonical seeds. Retain cloud measurement and gravity etiquette as optional premises; make the authority determine the actual improvisation rather than append status sentences.
